The fix is in and all three cases from the issue now render correctly. The blockquote nests under the nested item, becomes a sibling inside the top-level item, or breaks out of the list, depending on its indentation.

I added a `blockquoteBeginRegex` to `src/rules.ts`. The list-item loop in `src/Tokenizer.ts` now stops consuming lines when it sees one. It's built the same way as the existing fence, heading and HTML checks.

The spec and unit test scripts pass. I didn't run the lint, CJS or UMD checks, and I didn't add a regression test for this case.
